description: The forms case for Vue: a v-model textarea (typing with Enter inserting line breaks), a label for= focusing it, a label wrapping a v-model checkbox toggling it, a label wrapping a :value/@input text input focusing it. Controlled values without writes differ from Svelte: Vue patches the value of a text input or text area with :value (or v-model) at every re-render of its component where the live value differs (runtime-dom patchProp forces value; vModelText beforeUpdate), so typed text stays until an unrelated update re-renders the component and is then restored; a :checked checkbox is patched only when its value changes, so a toggle stays. The :value of a text area is also its value attribute (patchProp sets it)
